content.comment_body: Hello all! Is there a way to connect a [product_name] [article_no] to a SCADA system? I'm trying to use an OPC server, but I need to know which protocol works for [product_name] connected via PC cable.

Are you sure you want to connect such an older controller to a SCADA system? As I recall, it's possible to access all digital and analog inputs, outputs, and flags, but you'll need to send commands over the COM port and handle the byte responses. Unfortunately, I can't provide the protocol details right now. There's no off-the-shelf OPC server for this device. Do you have experience programming COM port transmissions in C++ or Visual Basic? It might be more practical to switch to a newer [product_name] controller and use utilities like Snap7 or Modbus TCP for current data access. Regards, [user_name]
The simplest solution would be to purchase a [product_name] version [version_no]. For example, integration with WinCC is shown here: [url]
It appears you are recommending this Czech website. Are you affiliated with it?
No, I'm not. There are simply more examples involving [product_name] on these pages.
However, there isn't an example for an older [product_name] [article_no]. Also, [company_name] has its own example sites.
Thanks for your responses. I'm considering getting a new [product_name] version [version_no] with compatible modules. Can I still use my existing power supply or is a new one necessary?
You can continue using your old power supply.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to interface an older [product_name] controller ([article_no]) with a SCADA system but is encountering protocol and compatibility issues, particularly due to the lack of standard OPC server support and modern communications. Community responses indicate that working with legacy hardware often requires specific knowledge of serial communications and custom programming, which makes integration challenging for those seeking ready-made solutions. The feedback advises considering newer controllers to simplify connection with current SCADA systems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for a straightforward method to connect the older [product_name] controller to SCADA, preferring minimal programming or setup. There is also a desire for backward compatibility when upgrading, particularly regarding reusing existing power supplies.
